pages.speaker: Character F
pages.text: WHY AREN'T YOU IN CLASS, HACHI-KEN!?

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: I FAKED BEING SICK TO SKIP OUT.

pages.speaker: Character E
pages.text: IT HELPS TO BE SUCH A STRAIGHT ARROW NORMALLY. NOBODY DOUBTS YOU AT TIMES LIKE THIS. AND I'M NOT SKIPPING MUCH, SO CATCHING UP ON STUDIES WILL BE EASY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I FIGURED THAT YOU MIGHT TRY AND SNEAK IN HERE TO GET YOUR STUFF WHEN NOBODY WAS AROUND, SO I WAITED FOR YOU TO SHOW UP AND I WAS RIGHT!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text:
YEAH.
I ALREADY TALKED TO ALL THE TEACHERS ABOUT IT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BUT... WHY ARE YOU DROP- PING OUT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I HAVE TO WORK TO SAVE UP SOME MONEY... IF I DON'T, I'LL CAUSE TROUBLE FOR AKI'S FAMILY.

pages.speaker: Character B
pages.text: WHEN MY OLD MAN TOOK OUT HIS LOAN TO EXPAND THE FARM,

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HE ASKED THEM TO BE HIS CO-SIGNER.

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: WHAT ABOUT ALL YOUR DREAMS!! ARE YOU JUST GOING TO GIVE UP!!

pages.speaker: Character E
pages.text: I WANT MY LITTLE SISTERS TO BE ABLE TO GO TO COLLEGE...

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: YOU'VE WORKED SO HARD TO GET THIS FAR!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU'RE RIGHT ... BASEBALL... TAKING OVER THE FARM...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THIS IS THE LAST OF IT.

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: HACHI-KEN-KUN... BE SURE TO FINISH SCHOOL, OKAY?

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: BE SURE TO DROP BY FROM TIME TO TIME.

pages.speaker: Character F
pages.text: DON'T GIVE ME THAT CRAP, YOU IDIOT ...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: PUTTING ON A FAKE SMILE ... AND ACTING LIKE YOU'RE FINE..

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ALL YOU EVER SAY IS, "THAT'S HOW THINGS ARE," OR "IT CAN'T BE HELPED."

pages.speaker: Character G
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH YOU'RE BOILING OVER ON THE INSIDE!!

pages.speaker: Character G
pages.text: STOP SPITTING OUT THAT BULLSHIT SO EASILY!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BECAUSE I ABSOLUTELY HATE IT WHEN YOU SAY CRAP LIKE THAT!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: KO-MABA ... CAME BY TO GET HIS THINGS TODAY.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HE TOLD ME THAT YOUR FAMILY WAS THE CO-SIGNER WHEN HIS DAD TOOK OUT HIS LOAN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I TOLD HIM NOT TO WORRY ABOUT US, BUT YOU KNOW ICHIRO-CHAN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THAT'S WHY... HE SAID HE HAS TO DROP OUT TO WORK...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF HE ALREADY EXPLAINED EVERYTHING, THAT MAKES THIS EASIER. THAT'S JUST THE WAY THINGS ARE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SO LET'S JUST NOT TALK ABOUT THIS ANY-MORE, OKAY?

pages.speaker: Character B
pages.text: I DON'T WANT YOU TO BE BUR- DENED BY THIS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SENSEI, HAVE YOU EVER BEEN TO A PLACE LIKE THIS BEFORE...?

pages.speaker: Character B
pages.text: WE HAVE TO SUCK IT UP.

pages.speaker: Character F
pages.text: SINCE PEOPLE WILL BE LOOKING AT YOUR FACE, IT'S MORE AMUSING IF YOU HAVE THAT HEAVY MAKE-UP ON... YOU WON'T BE FOUND OUT, SQUAD LEADER.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I GET THE FEELING THAT YOU ARE BEING SOFT ON HER...

pages.speaker: Character D
pages.text: YOU GOT SOME REASON FOR THAT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHE PISSED THE TEACHER OFF SO MUCH...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: JUST BECAUSE YOU HAVE PARENTS DOESN'T MEAN YOU'LL BE HAPPY, HUH?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHE'S THE ONLY ONE OF US WHO'S GOT EVEN ONE OF HER PARENTS AROUND.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SEEMS URIE AIN'T GOT EITHER OF HIS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ME TOO... MY FATHER WAS LIKE THAT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: ...AND MY MOM IS PROBABLY AROUND SOMEWHERE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: AS FOR TOORU... HIS WHOLE FAMILY WAS KILLED BY A GHOUL.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BUT, SEEING THAT SHE HAS "THAT FAMILY" DON'T YOU THINK SHE SHOULD WORK MORE!?

pages.speaker: Character G
pages.text: IF SHE'S GOT MONEY PROBLEMS THEN SHE SHOULD WORK AND EARN A LIVING...

pages.speaker: Character F
pages.text: ALL SHE EVER DOES IS LAZE AROUND!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: THEN SHE SHOULD CUT TIES WITH HER MOM AFTER A WHILE, AIN'T THAT RIGHT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: You are different from Saiko and us, aren't you?

pages.speaker: Character B
pages.text: ...TH-THAT'S RIGHT. SORRY FOR SAYING SOMETHING WEIRD...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT SEEMS MUCCHANKO HAS BEEN DRINKING SOMETHING. He reeks of alcohol.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SAIKO, YOUR DANCE IS OLD AS BALLS!!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU'RE DOING A GREAT BOX, MUCCHAN!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: DOESN'T THAT HAPPY LOOKING FACE PISS YOU OFF?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'S SUCH A LAME GROOVE. Roma feels so.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HE SHOULD HURRY UP AND SURRENDER THAT BODY

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: BEAUTIFUL WHITE KANEKI BACK TO ME... AND RETURN THAT

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'D BE OKAY IF HAISE DIED, RIGHT?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT SEEMS WE'LL GET TO SEE SOME INTERESTING THINGS, DOESN'T IT---?

pages.speaker: Character A
pages.text: I FEARED NOTHING. I HAD NOTHING TO LOSE. YET I HAD MY FIGHTING SPIRIT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU WERE ABLE TO STEP INTO THAT PART OF MY LIFE NICELY, DENSHI-CHIRO.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: I LAY RESTLESS FOR 3 DAYS AND 3 NIGHTS.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IT'S BEEN A YEAR SINCE THEN.

pages.speaker: Character B
pages.text: YOU'RE HALF A STEP FUR- THER AWAY NOW... COMPARED TO BACK THEN.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SHALL WE CALL OFF THIS DUEL?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: Just enough distance so that he can't touch me.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SNOW THIS MUCH EVERY YEAR IN THE CAPITAL?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: IF YOU DON'T WANT TO FIGHT THE DUEL.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: A sword is just a sharp tool solely for killing.
